positive_cases.name: executable_in_user_temp
positive_cases.scenario: Executable written into the per-user temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Directory and extension selections match and no filter applies.

positive_cases.name: library_in_public_directory
positive_cases.scenario: Library written into the public profile directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Directory and extension selections match and no filter applies.

negative_cases.name: document_in_user_temp
negative_cases.scenario: Document written into the per-user temporary directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Directory matches but the extension selection does not.

negative_cases.name: executable_in_program_files
negative_cases.scenario: Executable written into a managed installation directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Extension matches but the directory selection does not.

negative_cases.name: managed_update_agent_staging
negative_cases.scenario: Managed update agent stages a patch binary.
negative_cases.rationale: Both selections match but the update agent filter removes the event.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
